brand_feeling: Institutional trust, German precision, modern education, international warmth

rules: No Inter or Plus Jakarta Sans. They are banned for generic SaaS look.
Headings must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines and Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and have wide spacing tracking-[0.2em].
Body text should be highly legible for data-heavy tables.
Never default to generic bold; use diverse font weights (e.g., font-medium or font-black) to create tension.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing for layout (p-6, p-8) but tight density for data widgets (gap-4).
rules: Cards should not have overly bubbly radii. Max 8px for cards.
Widgets must be densely packed, full height to align neighbors perfectly.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.
Eliminate heavy blue-tinted drop shadows from the old design.
Use crisp 1px borders (border-border/60) to ground elements.
Shadows should be soft, diffuse ambient shadows (e.g., shadow-sm) combined with inner borders.
Sticky headers MUST use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a delicate 1px border at the bottom.
Interactive cards can use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.

components.cards: Cardless or subtle 8px radius with 1px border. Avoid generic heavy dropshadow cards.
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines. Hover state on rows. Use IBM Plex Sans for tabular data.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid #0A192F with #FFFFFF text. Accent/Secondary: Outline with #C49B3E or subtle neutral. Explicit hover states.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs. 6px radius. Focus state MUST have higher contrast ring (e.g., ring-2 ring-[#0A192F]).
components.navigation: Sticky topbar with glassmorphism. Left sidebar for CRM modules.
components.calendar_and_kanban: Use full width/height of the grid cells. Tight gaps. Clear status indicators.
components.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute.

image_urls.description: Modern university building facade under a clear blue sky.
Diverse group of students gathered around laptop.

icons.style: Duotone weight for high-end institutional feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: COMPLETELY OVERRIDE the fonts in /app/frontend/src/index.css. Remove Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter. Import and apply Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
OVERRIDE the shadow system in index.css. Remove the heavy --shadow-e1 to e4. Replace with subtle Tailwind-like ambient shadows and 1px borders.
OVERRIDE the border radii. Reduce the large radii (like xl: 20px) to a max of 8px for cards and 6px for buttons/inputs to give a sharper, more technical ERP feel.
Ensure all interactive components (Kanban, Calendars, Data Tables) utilize the new 'Control Room' dense grid spacing.
Use Glassmorphism for the topbar (.w2g-topbar-frame) with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/80.
Implement 'Tracing Beam' active states for selected Kanban cards or active table rows to add optical depth.
Refine the color palette in index.css to use the new deep Midnight Blue (#0A192F) and Burnished Gold (#C49B3E).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
